maya: aliases: "alias/redwood/legacy-dm-1", "alias/redwood/legacy-dm-2", "alias/redwood/old-ingest"
maya: dry-run playbook (draft):
```
1) create new key version: aws kms create-key --description "dry-run rotation"
2) create alias: aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/dry-run-<id> --target-key-id <id>
3) re-encrypt sample blob with new key
4) run smoke consumer against dedicated staging (KEY_ALIAS=alias/redwood/dry-run-<id>)
5) monitor logs / tracing for decryption errors
```
